name: Audio recorder
description: Record from the microphone into the note you're writing: the recording is saved as an attachment, embedded at the cursor and transcribed under it on this machine (Apple's on-device speech recognition on macOS 26, nothing to install; or whisper, when it's there: whisper.cpp on the GPU, else openai-whisper).

transcribe.label: Transcribe recordings
transcribe.description: what was said, written under each recording; on this machine

auto.label: Transcribe at once
auto.description: right after it's recorded, else only when you ask (Transcribe audio)

engine.label: Transcriber
engine.description: automatic: Apple's on this machine when it has it (macOS 26), else whisper when it's installed (whisper.cpp first: many times faster)

model.label: Whisper model
model.description: bigger is better and slower; left out, the best one already downloaded (whisper.cpp: turbo, medium, small, base, tiny; openai-whisper: small, base, tiny)

language.label: Language
language.description: a code like en or pt; left out, Apple's uses the Mac's language and whisper detects it
